toegepas.voor: Die klip met die goud in vorm 'n dun laag
toegepas.na: Die klip waarin die goud sit, vorm 'n dun laag
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'met die goud in vorm' reads awkwardly and can be misparsed as 'in vorm'; the relative clause is clearer and matches the glossary entry for rif.
toegepas.fout: 'Die klip met die goud in vorm' makes the reader stumble, since 'in vorm' reads as a phrase on first pass.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The relative clause reads naturally, says the same thing, and leaves the protected wordings in the paragraph untouched.

laat_vaar.na: en die werk in die myn laat doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'sy' could refer to the business or the mine; naming the mine's work removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'sy' naturally points to the mine and either reading means the same, while 'in die myn' narrows the work to underground and rewords a shared glossary definition.
